name: tips_crm_multi_territory_assignments_and_exit_log
query: ALTER TABLE tips_crm.team_invites ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS territory_ids uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[]; ALTER TABLE tips_crm.notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS territory_id uuid REFERENCES tips_crm.territories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; ALTER TABLE tips_crm.notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS captured_at timestamptz; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS notifications_duty_captured_at_idx ON tips_crm.notifications(kind, captured_at DESC) WHERE kind = 'duty'; UPDATE tips_crm.team_invites SET territory_ids = ARRAY[territory_id] WHERE territory_id IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(territory_ids) = 0; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.tips_crm_create_invite(text, text, text, text); CREATE FUNCTION public.tips_crm_create_invite(invitee_email text, invite_role_key text, invite_territory text DEFAULT NULL, invite_territory_key text DEFAULT NULL, invite_territory_keys text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[]) RETURNS TABLE(invite_id uuid, invite_token text, expires_at timestamptz) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'tips_crm', 'auth', 'public' AS $$ DECLARE new_invite tips_crm.team_invites%ROWTYPE; DECLARE selected_ids uuid[]; DECLARE selected_labels text; DECLARE selected_primary uuid; DECLARE normalized_keys text[]; BEGIN IF NOT tips_crm.has_permission('manage_users') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'User management permission required'; END IF; IF invitee_email !~* '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid email address'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tips_crm.roles WHERE key = invite_role_key AND is_active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Role is not available'; END IF; normalized_keys := ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT trim(value) FROM unnest(coalesce(invite_territory_keys, '{}'::text[])) value WHERE trim(value) <> ''); IF cardinality(normalized_keys) = 0 AND nullif(trim(coalesce(invite_territory_key, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN normalized_keys := ARRAY[trim(invite_territory_key)]; END IF; SELECT array_agg(t.id ORDER BY t.name), string_agg(t.name, '، ' ORDER BY t.name) INTO selected_ids, selected_labels FROM tips_crm.territories t WHERE t.client_key = ANY(normalized_keys) AND t.is_active; IF cardinality(normalized_keys) > 0 AND coalesce(cardinality(selected_ids), 0) <> cardinality(normalized_keys) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected territories are unavailable'; END IF; IF invite_role_key IN ('sales_rep', 'medical_rep') AND coalesce(cardinality(selected_ids), 0) = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one territory is required for field representatives'; END IF; selected_primary := selected_ids[1]; INSERT INTO tips_crm.team_invites(email, role_key, territory_label, territory_id, territory_ids, invited_by) VALUES (lower(invitee_email), invite_role_key, coalesce(selected_labels, nullif(invite_territory, '')), selected_primary, coalesce(selected_ids, '{}'::uuid[]), auth.uid()) RETURNING * INTO new_invite; PERFORM tips_crm.log_audit('invite_created', 'team_invite', new_invite.id::text, jsonb_build_object('email', new_invite.email, 'role_key', new_invite.role_key, 'territory_count', cardinality(new_invite.territory_ids))); RETURN QUERY SELECT new_invite.id, new_invite.invite_token, new_invite.expires_at; END; $$; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.tips_crm_list_invites(); CREATE FUNCTION public.tips_crm_list_invites() RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, role_key text, territory_label text, territory_key text, territory_keys text[], status text, invite_token text, expires_at timestamptz, created_at timestamptz) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'tips_crm', 'auth', 'public' AS $$ BEGIN IF NOT tips_crm.has_permission('manage_users') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'User management permission required'; END IF; RETURN QUERY SELECT i.id, i.email, i.role_key, coalesce(string_agg(t.name, '، ' ORDER BY t.name), i.territory_label), primary_territory.client_key, coalesce(array_agg(t.client_key ORDER BY t.name) FILTER (WHERE t.client_key IS NOT NULL), '{}'::text[]), i.status, i.invite_token, i.expires_at, i.created_at FROM tips_crm.team_invites i LEFT JOIN tips_crm.territories primary_territory ON primary_territory.id = i.territory_id LEFT JOIN tips_crm.territories t ON t.id = ANY(i.territory_ids) GROUP BY i.id, primary_territory.client_key ORDER BY i.created_at DESC; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tips_crm_accept_invite(token text) RETURNS TABLE(role_key text, territory_label text) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'tips_crm', 'auth', 'public' AS $$ DECLARE invited tips_crm.team_invites%ROWTYPE; DECLARE current_email text; DECLARE assigned_ids uuid[]; BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'; END IF; SELECT lower(email) INTO current_email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid(); SELECT * INTO invited FROM tips_crm.team_invites WHERE invite_token = token FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitation not found'; END IF; IF invited.status <> 'pending' OR invited.expires_at < now() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitation is no longer valid'; END IF; IF lower(invited.email) <> current_email THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invitation email does not match the signed-in account'; END IF; assigned_ids := CASE WHEN cardinality(invited.territory_ids) > 0 THEN invited.territory_ids WHEN invited.territory_id IS NOT NULL THEN ARRAY[invited.territory_id] ELSE '{}'::uuid[] END; UPDATE tips_crm.profiles SET role_key = invited.role_key, is_active = true, updated_at = now() WHERE id = auth.uid(); DELETE FROM tips_crm.territory_assignments WHERE profile_id = auth.uid(); INSERT INTO tips_crm.territory_assignments(territory_id, profile_id, assigned_by) SELECT territory_id, auth.uid(), invited.invited_by FROM unnest(assigned_ids) territory_id ON CONFLICT (territory_id, profile_id) DO NOTHING; UPDATE tips_crm.team_invites SET status = 'accepted' WHERE id = invited.id; PERFORM tips_crm.log_audit('invite_accepted', 'team_invite', invited.id::text, jsonb_build_object('role_key', invited.role_key, 'territory_count', cardinality(assigned_ids))); RETURN QUERY SELECT invited.role_key, invited.territory_label; END; $$; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.tips_crm_my_profile(); CREATE FUNCTION public.tips_crm_my_profile() RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, email text, role_key text, role_name text, permissions text[], is_active boolean, must_change_password boolean, territory_key text, territory_label text, territory_keys text[], territory_labels text[]) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'tips_crm', 'auth', 'public' AS $$ SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.email, p.role_key, r.display_name, r.permissions, p.is_active, p.must_change_password, assigned.keys[1], assigned.labels[1], coalesce(assigned.keys, '{}'::text[]), coalesce(assigned.labels, '{}'::text[]) FROM tips_crm.profiles p JOIN tips_crm.roles r ON r.key = p.role_key LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(t.client_key ORDER BY t.name) keys, array_agg(t.name ORDER BY t.name) labels FROM tips_crm.territory_assignments a JOIN tips_crm.territories t ON t.id = a.territory_id WHERE a.profile_id = p.id) assigned ON true WHERE p.id = auth.uid(); $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tips_crm_set_profile_territories(target_profile_id uuid, selected_territory_keys text[]) RETURNS TABLE(territory_keys text[], territory_labels text[]) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'tips_crm', 'auth', 'public' AS $$ DECLARE target_role text; DECLARE selected_ids uuid[]; DECLARE normalized_keys text[]; BEGIN IF NOT tips_crm.has_permission('manage_users') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'User management permission required'; END IF; SELECT role_key INTO target_role FROM tips_crm.profiles WHERE id = target_profile_id FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Employee profile was not found'; END IF; normalized_keys := ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT trim(value) FROM unnest(coalesce(selected_territory_keys, '{}'::text[])) value WHERE trim(value) <> ''); SELECT array_agg(t.id ORDER BY t.name) INTO selected_ids FROM tips_crm.territories t WHERE t.client_key = ANY(normalized_keys) AND t.is_active; IF coalesce(cardinality(selected_ids), 0) <> cardinality(normalized_keys) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected territories are unavailable'; END IF; IF target_role IN ('sales_rep', 'medical_rep') AND coalesce(cardinality(selected_ids), 0) = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one territory is required for field representatives'; END IF; DELETE FROM tips_crm.territory_assignments WHERE profile_id = target_profile_id; INSERT INTO tips_crm.territory_assignments(territory_id, profile_id, assigned_by) SELECT territory_id, target_profile_id, auth.uid() FROM unnest(coalesce(selected_ids, '{}'::uuid[])) territory_id ON CONFLICT (territory_id, profile_id) DO NOTHING; PERFORM tips_crm.log_audit('territories_assigned', 'profile', target_profile_id::text, jsonb_build_object('territory_keys', normalized_keys)); RETURN QUERY SELECT coalesce(array_agg(t.client_key ORDER BY t.name), '{}'::text[]), coalesce(array_agg(t.name ORDER BY t.name), '{}'::text[]) FROM tips_crm.territory_assignments a JOIN tips_crm.territories t ON t.id = a.territory_id WHERE a.profile_id = target_profile_id; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tips_crm_raise_territory_exit_alert(territory_key text, captured_at_input timestamptz DEFAULT now()) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'tips_crm', 'auth', 'public' AS $$ DECLARE assigned_territory tips_crm.territories%ROWTYPE; DECLARE actor tips_crm.profiles%ROWTYPE; DECLARE message_body text; BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'; END IF; SELECT * INTO actor FROM tips_crm.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid(); SELECT t.* INTO assigned_territory FROM tips_crm.territory_assignments a JOIN tips_crm.territories t ON t.id = a.territory_id WHERE a.profile_id = auth.uid() AND t.client_key = territory_key AND t.is_active LIMIT 1; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assigned territory was not found'; END IF; IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tips_crm.notifications n WHERE n.created_by = auth.uid() AND n.kind = 'duty' AND n.territory_id = assigned_territory.id AND n.created_at >= captured_at_input - interval '10 minutes' LIMIT 1) THEN RETURN false; END IF; message_body := coalesce(actor.full_name, 'مندوب') || ' خارج منطقة ' || assigned_territory.name || ' أثناء الدوام المباشر.'; INSERT INTO tips_crm.notifications(recipient_id, title, body, kind, created_by, territory_id, captured_at) SELECT p.id, 'مندوب خارج نطاق المنطقة', message_body, 'duty', auth.uid(), assigned_territory.id, captured_at_input FROM tips_crm.profiles p JOIN tips_crm.roles r ON r.key = p.role_key WHERE p.is_active AND ('all' = ANY(r.permissions) OR 'view_team_data' = ANY(r.permissions) OR 'manage_territories' = ANY(r.permissions)); PERFORM tips_crm.log_audit('territory_exit_alert', 'territory', assigned_territory.id::text, jsonb_build_object('territory_key', assigned_territory.client_key, 'captured_at', captured_at_input)); RETURN true; END; $$; CREATE FUNCTION public.tips_crm_list_territory_exit_alerts(from_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL, to_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL, target_profile_id uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, occurred_at timestamptz, employee_id uuid, employee_name text, territory_key text, territory_name text, title text, body text, status text) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'tips_crm', 'auth', 'public' AS $$ BEGIN IF NOT tips_crm.has_permission('view_team_data') AND NOT tips_crm.has_permission('manage_territories') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Team data permission required'; END IF; RETURN QUERY SELECT n.id, coalesce(n.captured_at, n.created_at), n.created_by, coalesce(p.full_name, 'مندوب غير معروف'), t.client_key, coalesce(t.name, 'منطقة غير محددة'), n.title, n.body, CASE WHEN n.read_at IS NULL THEN 'غير مقروء' ELSE 'تمت المراجعة' END FROM tips_crm.notifications n LEFT JOIN tips_crm.profiles p ON p.id = n.created_by LEFT JOIN tips_crm.territories t ON t.id = n.territory_id WHERE n.kind = 'duty' AND (from_at IS NULL OR coalesce(n.captured_at, n.created_at) >= from_at) AND (to_at IS NULL OR coalesce(n.captured_at, n.created_at) <= to_at) AND (target_profile_id IS NULL OR n.created_by = target_profile_id) ORDER BY coalesce(n.captured_at, n.created_at) DESC LIMIT 1000; END; $$; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.tips_crm_create_invite(text, text, text, text, text[]), public.tips_crm_list_invites(), public.tips_crm_accept_invite(text), public.tips_crm_my_profile(), public.tips_crm_set_profile_territories(uuid, text[]), public.tips_crm_raise_territory_exit_alert(text, timestamptz), public.tips_crm_list_territory_exit_alerts(timestamptz, timestamptz, uuid) TO authenticated;
